text:
Maria S: FYI OrionSupply just pinged — they split our EU GPU shipment across two manifests and the marketplace reservations collided. We have two reservations pointing at the same SKU range. Can we triage?
Alex K: link to manifest? can you paste reservation IDs?
Maria S: https://partners.orion/s/1543 — partner says manifests MFT-98765 and MFT-98766. Reservation IDs I can see in console: res_45321 and res_45322. UI shows both in 'allocated' state for the same customer window.
OrionSupply: Hey team — apologies. Trucking split on origin. We can reassign inventory to a single manifest but need your confirmation to change the reservation targets (ETA 72h normal, we can expedite to 48h for EU crossdock).
Tim L: This is the classic SKU-lock collision. Quick ask: which customer quotas are impacted if we put res_45322 into a provision-hold?
Raj P: If we hold res_45322, customers on that reservation will slip 3–5 business days unless we backfill from on-demand cloud. I can run a quick diff:

```
# quick query
curl -s "https://console.redwood/api/reservations?ids=res_45321,res_45322" | jq '.[] | {id: .id, status: .state, customer: .owner, region: .region}'
```

Maria S: ran that — output shows both in eu-west-1, both tied to the same PO (PO-9082) but different reservation UUIDs. Likely partner assigned split shipments to two internal picks.
Alex K: two options: 1) ask OrionSupply to consolidate manifests (partner action, takes time) 2) patch marketplace to merge reservations server-side (risky for audit trail) 3) carve a temporary on-demand buffer for affected customers.
OrionSupply: We recommend option 1. We'll issue a consolidation manifest and update the EDI. We can prioritize customers in PO-9082 if you give us a list of priority reservation IDs by noon CET.
Jess W: Sales needs the prioritized customer list ASAP — they want to notify SLs with the expected slide and credits offer.
Tim L: Operationally, I don't want to merge reservations without a clear audit record. Suggest: set res_45322 -> "provision-hold" tag, mark customer affected in console, then OrionSupply consolidates manifests. After consolidation we release the hold and run a reconcile job to reassign allocations. Low-risk and reversible.
Raj P: I can implement the provision-hold flow and a reconcile script. Will need a small DB migration flag. ETA 4 hours to push a safe toggle to staging, 8 hours to prod if approved.
Maria S: sounds good. @OrionSupply please confirm you will consolidate and update EDI by EOD tomorrow if we tag res_45322. If yes we'll proceed with hold + reconcile.
OrionSupply: Confirmed — we will consolidate MFT-98766 into MFT-98765 and update the manifest by 2025-06-21 18:00 CET. We will send a corrected ASN and offer a 5% service credit on the affected units.
shipper-bot: Manifest update scheduled: MFT-98766 -> MFT-98765 consolidation queued (job 48291). ETA 48h.
Alex K: ok, plan: Raj implements hold + reconcile; Tim owns ops rollout; Jess drafts customer comms; Maria will coordinate with OrionSupply and post status here.
Jess W: I'll draft outbound and ping SalesOps — will post copy for review in #partnerships-liaison. :email:
Raj P: starting work now. I'll post the staging toggle and test logs here when ready.
Tim L: once Raj has staging toggle, I'll run the reconcile dry-run with one reservation to confirm idempotency.
Maria S: thanks everyone. Action items in one line: Raj -> hold + reconcile; Tim -> ops test/review; Jess -> comms; Maria -> partner coord; OrionSupply -> consolidate manifest + ASN update.
Alex K: also: check SLA exposure. Finance flagged PO-9082 as enterprise with potential SLA credit. Jess, loop in finance if we accept partner credit.
Jess W: doing.
Maria S: will update last_message_ts when consolidation completes. Keeping thread open.
